rows.text: The Assembly reports that 'The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly, Lord Lasike administered the oaths of office for members of the Legislative Assembly this morning Friday 14 th of January 2011'; all members, including the people's and nobles' representatives, Prime Minister Lord Tu'ivakano and his Cabinet Ministers, took their oaths, and the House elected Sifa Tu'utafaiva chairman of the Whole House Committee.
rows.uncertainty: The earliest dated primary record found of Lasike acting as Speaker. It does not state the day of his royal appointment or record a Speaker's oath; the oaths are members' oaths.
